title: Breakup Status Unclear: Suki Mellow addresses Kanel Joseph on stream; fans speculate

She also suggested they may be at different stages of life with different priorities. Although Suki has not confirmed a breakup, her emotional remarks and fans’ reactions have fueled speculation about the status of their relationship.
